intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Alexandria for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 24 (Aladdin the Christmas Camel at Mount Vernon) through January 7, 2027, with the Alexandria Scottish Walk Holiday Parade and the Holiday Boat Parade of Lights (both December 5), the Old Town Alexandria Christmas Market and Holiday Craft Show (December 12), Christmas Illuminations at Mount Vernon (December 19 and 20) and the Waterskiing Santa Show at the Alexandria Waterfront (December 24) along the way, plus Bright Nights at Cameron Run (running now to January 3, 2027). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Alexandria

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Alexandria
  • 3 free events, including the Scottish Walk Holiday Parade, the Holiday Boat Parade of Lights and the Old Town Alexandria Christmas Market and Holiday Craft Show
  • Meet Santa: the Waterskiing Santa Show at the Alexandria Waterfront (December 24) and Santa at Bright Nights at Cameron Run (nightly through December 23)
  • Parades and lights: the Scottish Walk Holiday Parade (December 5), the Holiday Boat Parade of Lights (December 5), Bright Nights at Cameron Run and Christmas Illuminations at Mount Vernon (December 19 and 20)
  • Animals and history: Aladdin the Christmas Camel and Mount Vernon by Candlelight at George Washington's Mount Vernon
  • Season: November 24 to January 7, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Alexandria families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Washington, DC, which covers ZooLights, the National Christmas Tree and the Nutcracker at the Warner Theatre.
